text:
Maria: Quick status on Solaris onboarding — they hit a latency/TD degrade when traffic >120 RPS and flagged it as a renewal concern. I ran a perf pass and have a small, actionable plan: quantize the large model with q8_compat for cost/latency, pilot a model-swap to redwood-medium-v1 for low-latency paths with auto-fallback to large for complex prompts, and add a routing rule based on prompt_complexity + token budget. Want to coordinate canary + enablement call.

Sam: +1 on the high-level. Proposal for canary: 10% traffic -> redwood-medium-v1 for 48h with KV cache pre-warm. Use quant profile `q8_compat` for medium and `q8_safe` for large during canary. Expect ~25-35% token-cost reduction. We'll run the existing solaris-eval prompt set to check quality delta.

Derek: Ops notes: we can implement routing via policy engine. Example rule we can push:

```yaml
- name: solaris_complexity_routing
  when:
    - header.prompt_complexity >= 0.7
  route:
    - primary: redwood-large-v1
    - fallback: redwood-medium-v1
  else:
    - primary: redwood-medium-v1
    - fallback: redwood-large-v1
  canary: 0.10
  metrics: [p50_latency, p95_latency, token_cost_delta]
```

Also enable prefix/KV caching for the 1st 5 tokens of interactive sessions — that should cut warm-up overhead. Capacity check: Dedicated pool has headroom for a 10% canary; no infra blockers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout job started for redwood-medium-v1 at 1932468045 (canary=10%). Monitoring stream: logs/redwood/solar-canary.

Jenna: Renewal-risk signal: current score ~0.62 (medium). Let's prioritize an enablement + feedback session with Solaris product + infra leads next Tue or Wed. Action items for the call: share the eval results, demo the fallback logic, get acceptance criteria for quality delta (we need to keep similarity >= 0.96 on solaris-eval). I'll prep the slide + runbook. Also capture post-call feedback in the 'solar-onboard-feedback' doc.

Maria: TL;DR & next steps:
- [ ] Sam: start 10% canary (redwood-medium-v1) + run solaris-eval (owner: Sam)
- [ ] Maria: run quant compare q8_compat vs q8_safe and produce quality/cost table (owner: Maria)
- [ ] Derek: push routing policy + enable KV caching (owner: Derek)
- [ ] Jenna: schedule enablement + renewal touchpoint with Solaris and collect feedback (owner: Jenna)
- [ ] All: confirm rollback criteria (latency p95 > 250ms or quality drop > 4%)

Ping me if you need datasets or I can join the call. Solaris CSM already notified and expects the canary. :thumbsup:
